description: This file defines a REST API for managing themes in the Superset application, including CRUD operations, bulk delete, exporting/importing themes via ZIP files, and setting/unsetting system default and dark themes. It uses Flask and Flask-AppBuilder for routing and security, and interacts with theme commands and models.

classes.name: ThemeRestApi
classes.description: A REST API class for managing themes, including CRUD operations, bulk delete, import/export, and system theme settings.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a theme by ID, handling various exceptions and returning appropriate responses.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Bulk deletes themes based on provided IDs.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates a theme with provided JSON data.

methods.name: _create_theme
methods.description: Helper method to create a theme within a transaction.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports selected themes as a ZIP file containing YAML files.

methods.name: import_
methods.description: Imports themes from an uploaded ZIP file.

methods.name: set_system_default
methods.description: Sets a theme as the system default.

methods.name: set_system_dark
methods.description: Sets a theme as the system dark theme.
